shortDescription: Bond traders are treating collateralized French bank bonds as safer than French government debt, according to Bloomberg. The unusual pricing reflects a “crazy” inversion in French credit markets, Bloomberg reported.

title: GEOPOLITICS | French Bank Bonds Seen Safer Than Government Debt
